subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to confirm your recent flight booking from Los Angeles to New York on June 15th. Your flight details are as follows: Flight Number: ABC123 Departure: 10:00 AM Arrival: 5:00 PM Seat: 12A Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure time. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. Thank you for choosing our airline. Safe travels! Best regards, Airline Customer Service
